page_title: WHU 1-2 NOT | West Ham v Nottingham Forest 06/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Tony Harrington has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Tony Harrington interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Morato (Nottingham).
90+7' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will take the free kick.
90+6' The game has begun to heat up. Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+5' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and it's Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+4' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+4' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+2' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Morato replaces Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 2 Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Alphonse Areola to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
88' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is going to take the penalty!
87' Referee Tony Harrington awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

86' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nottingham players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tony Harrington interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
85' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Nottingham for a penalty. Play continues.
85' Alphonse Areola (West Ham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tony Harrington no option but to blow his whistle.
85' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
84' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
84' Pablo (West Ham) commits a rough foul. Tony Harrington stops the game and makes a call. Nottingham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
84' A lofted cross from Neco Williams (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
82' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
81' The corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is intercepted by the defence.

81' A pass lands at the feet of Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
80' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Mateus Fernandes is replaced by Freddie Potts (West Ham).
78' The resulting corner from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
78' The free kick is delivered by Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Great save! Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Matz Sels.
75' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
74' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
73' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

73' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Alphonse Areola has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
72' Pablo (West Ham) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
70' Nuno Espirito Santo is stunned as referee Tony Harrington shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
67' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
65' It looks like Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Tony Harrington won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
64' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
63' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ezra Mayers (West Ham) replacing Oliver Scarles.
63' Here is a change. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Pablo.
63' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
62' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
61' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
60' Murillo (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. Tony Harrington had a clear view and blows his whistle.
59' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
59' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Nottingham will take a corner kick.

58' Murillo (Nottingham) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a low shot goalwards. The ball is directed towards the middle of the goal, but it lacks power and Alphonse Areola pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
58' The free kick is taken by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham), but ball is cleared.
57' Tony Harrington couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tomas Soucek (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.
55' Corner kick. Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is ready to send the ball into the box.

55' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
53' The goal by West Ham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
53' Wait! Referee Tony Harrington has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' Goal! Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
51' He should have scored! Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
49' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
48' A wild pass somehow finds Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
47' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' Sean Dyche makes a half-time substitution. Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) comes on in place of Omari Hutchinson.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) launches a cross from the corner, but Alphonse Areola is alert to thwart the effort.
42' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
41' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Jarrod Bowen collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
40' West Ham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
38' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Ola Aina (Nottingham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

36' The cross into the penalty area from Tomas Soucek (West Ham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
34' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was too forceful with his tackle and Tony Harrington interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
31' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
29' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
28' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Crysencio Summerville.
27' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
26' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
23' The foul by Igor Jesus (Nottingham) was seen by Tony Harrington who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' A precise low pass is received by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
21' Ola Aina (Nottingham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
20' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Tony Harrington has a clear sight and sees a foul from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
13' 1 - 0 Murillo (Nottingham) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner inside the left post of his own net.
13' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) steps up to send the ball in.
11' Alphonse Areola comes off his line to intercept the corner from Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham).

10' Close! Neco Williams (Nottingham) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out. Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.
9' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
6' The ball is laid off to Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Matz Sels to make a decent save.
6' Ola Aina (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.

5' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
3' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
3' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. West Ham force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and West Ham will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tony Harrington.
